newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC says all three agencies confirm rating.
newsitem.headline: SBC says all three agencies confirm rating.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp (SBC) said all three main ratings agencies -- Moody's, IBCA and Standard & Poor's -- had confirmed the bank's rating after news it would revise its method for calculating loan loss provisions.
Earlier today SBC said it would adopt the ACRA method -- Actuarial Credit Risk Accounting -- for calculating credit risks from customer loan defaults.
SBC estimated that switching to ACRA and restructuring its domestic operations will lead to an expected net loss of 1.9 billion Swiss francs for 1996.
S&P and IBCA have already announced affirmation of their ratings of SBC.
